subject: SIG / ISO / SOC2 — collector triage, priority artifacts & delivery windows
messages:
From: Lucinda Hayes <lucinda.hayes@zenithfin.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@zenithfin.com
Date: 2027-04-04T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: SIG / ISO / SOC2 intake — prioritized controls & artifacts

Sofia,

Thanks again for taking this on. Attached is Part A of the SIG matrix we've started (sig_questionnaire_part_A.xlsx). Our audit window is the week of May 9; to make that work we need a prioritized list of controls you can substantiate, the expected artifact types (logs, screenshots, architecture diagrams, config exports), and a delivery cadence for collectors we can ingest into our assurance portal.

High level asks:
- One-paragraph mapping for any control you cannot substantiate with artifacts (i.e., narrative only).
- Preferred artifact delivery (S3/Drive upload or scannable CSV index)
- Retention proof for logs (how you demonstrate retention/immutability)

Can you get a collector/owner list and rough delivery windows by EOD Monday? Tim (procurement) is cc'd for timeline visibility.

Appreciate it,

Lucinda Hayes
Head of Information Assurance
Zenith Financial Services
[Attachment: sig_questionnaire_part_A.xlsx (xlsx, 980KB)]
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lucinda Hayes <lucinda.hayes@zenithfin.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-04T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / ISO / SOC2 intake — prioritized controls & artifacts

Hi Lucinda — thanks for the worksheet and the clear window. We can meet the May 9 target if we split the work into two parallel tracks:

1) Rapid substantiation: identify 40–60% of SIG controls we can support with existing artifacts (logs, config exports, screenshots). Deliverable: evidence_index_v3.csv plus a short mapping doc for any control we only have narrative for.
2) Collector sprint: assign internal collectors to pull a reproducible bundle for the remaining controls (e.g., system config exports, KMS attestations, key rotation logs).

Proposed owners: Karthik will lead collector assignments and data pulls; Markus will help with cryptographic/KMS artifacts; Tessa will coordinate packaging and the Drive/S3 intake.

Questions for clarity before we lock windows:
- Do you need raw log archives (gzipped) or aggregated CSVs with timestamps?
- Is on-prem proof (screenshots of appliance UI + config export) required for any control families?

I created a shared intake folder and will upload a skeleton collector assignment CSV by EOD for your comments: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2Bz_zenith-artifacts

Plan to deliver a prioritized collector_owner list by Monday EOD. If that works, we'll follow up with a Mutual Action Plan (milestones + owners).

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Security PM, Redwood Inference
[Calendar: +1 (415) 555-0143]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-05T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Collector assignment draft and control-family notes

Sofia — attaching my draft collector_assignment.csv and a few quick notes below.

Attachment: collector_assignment.csv (CSV, 12KB)

Notes (high level):
- Data access controls (SIG V2: DA): we can provide IAM policy snapshots + CloudTrail export slices (30 days) for initial substantiation. Owner: Karthik. Delivery: Apr 12 (CSV index + zipped logs).
- Cryptography (SIG V2: CR): KMS key metadata + rotation history + HSM attestation screenshots. Owner: Markus. Delivery: Apr 14 (archive + PDF screenshots).
- System config and patching (SIG V2: SG): config exports from orchestration + vulnerability scan reports; Tessa to package. Delivery: Apr 16.

Two caveats:
1) For long retention proofs we will provide a retention policy excerpt and a sample WORM/immutable bucket manifest. Full retention rollups for years will need a formal request — we can provide scope-limited exports for the audit window.
2) Some legacy appliance screenshots require manual capture; estimating 1–2 days for that subset.

I'll upload collector_assignment.csv to the shared Drive folder and flag the files in the evidence_index_v3.csv skeleton.

-karthik
From: Lucinda Hayes <lucinda.hayes@zenithfin.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tim O'Leary <tim.oleary@zenithfin.com>, procurement@zenithfin.com
Date: 2027-04-06T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Collector assignment draft and control-family notes

Team — this all sounds workable, thank you. A few follow-ups:

- For log retention, we need evidence that logs are not truncated within the audit window and a signed manifest showing retention policy. A retention policy excerpt + immutable bucket manifest is fine for now.
- For KMS/HSM proof: a screenshot of the HSM appliance plus a KMS key metadata export will be required; if you have a third-party attestation (FIPS or vendor statement) attach it.
- On on-prem screenshots: yes, we need the config export + UI screenshot for any control referencing physical appliance config.

Procurement note (Tim): please get the PO in place for the evidence ingestion service by Apr 15 so we can run the portal imports the week of Apr 19.

Lucinda

Lucinda / Tim — thanks for the confirmations. Finalizing the Mutual Action Plan below and will upload the signed CSV indexes to the shared Drive. HubSpot deal: HS-57219.

Mutual Action Plan (milestones & owners):
- Apr 12: Initial evidence_index_v3.csv (Karthik) — IAM snapshots, CloudTrail slices
- Apr 14: KMS/HSM bundle (Markus) — key metadata export + screenshots + vendor attestation (if available)
- Apr 16: System config & patch reports (Tessa) — orchestration exports + vuln scan PDF
- Apr 19–23: Portal ingest window (Zenith) — Tim/Procurement to confirm PO by Apr 15

Delivery format: file uploads to the Drive folder + a scannable CSV index (evidence_index_v3.csv). For large archives we'll provide signed manifests.
